source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: This model's melee attacks may re-roll their Wound rolls when the target is a CHARACTER or a MONSTER unit. Whenever an enemy unit that is a CHARACTER or MONSTER is destroyed by it, it regains lost wounds, up to D6 of them.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 9 of 157 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.attacks: melee attacks targeting CHARACTER or MONSTER units

effects.trigger: destroys an enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER unit
